about: Virginia Hammerle is the founder and managing attorney of Hammerle Morris Law Firm. She is Board-Certified in Civil Trial Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization and an Accredited Estate Planner. Ms. Hammerle provides unmatched counsel and support to a diverse range of clients who have legal needs involving any of the following:

Over the course of her legal career, Ms. Hammerle has successfully handled highly complex civil, guardianship, estate and trust matters for her clients. During that time, she has achieved remarkable success protecting her clients' rights and interests and helping them achieve their goals and the favorable outcomes they seek efficiently and cost-effectively. She has gained a reputation for her impassioned advocacy at all turns.

A 1979 graduate of the University of Missouri, Ms. Hammerle obtained her Juris Doctor from the Southern Methodist University Dedman School of Law in 1982. She is admitted to practice before the U.S. District Courts for the Northern, Southern and Eastern Districts of Texas, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 5th Circuit and the U.S. Supreme Court.

Ms. Hammerle is a Fellow with the Texas Bar Foundation, and she is an active member of the National Academy of Elder Law Attorneys, Texas Bankers Association, and Wealth Counsel, among her other professional affiliations. She has served as Chairman of the Board of Trustees of a local hospital, and been honored with the Kiwanis Hixson Award for her contributions to the organization.
